flags.why: The common adverbial meaning ‘all; completely; at all’, as in ‘không biết gì ráo’, is missing ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-r%C3%A1o)).
flags.fix: adv [colloquial, Southern] | all; completely; at all (in negatives); ex: Tôi không biết gì ráo. = I don't know anything at all.

flags.why: ‘Để dụ’ expresses his purpose, whereas ‘sweet-talked her into lending’ says that he succeeded.
flags.fix: He spoke sweetly to try to persuade her to lend him money.

flags.why: In this example, ‘dân tình’ means the people who are dissatisfied, rather than public mood or sentiment.
flags.fix: Ông đi khắp nơi để tìm hiểu dân tình. = He travelled everywhere to learn about public sentiment.
